description: HSE approval date set to the version 3 date (2022-06-27): the indication in its current wording ("First line treatment of patients with low grade B cell Non Hodgkin's lymphoma (NHL)") is present on 2023-10-01 in version 3 of the treatment regimen (https://web.archive.org/web/20231001182450/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/lymphoma-myeloma/r%20cvp%20v3%20293.pdf) but not in version 2 on 2019-07-18 (https://web.archive.org/web/20190718155234/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/lymphoma-myeloma/293.pdf), which reads "First line treatment for patients with stage 3/4 follicular lymphoma", as version 1 did. The version 3 version note says "Clarification of indication".
